title: Maribell B Possible NDE 6337
content: Since the day I was born, I got sick very easily. I had gone in and out of the hospital several times prior to age five. I was always careful with my health back then, but sometimes I went overboard. One time when I was sick, I went to the hospital with my mom. The doctors thought it was a simple cold and sent us back home. An hour or two later, we returned and I was on the verge of death. I passed out, thinking it was a dream. I don't remember having a body, but I remember there were two kind, warming presences with me, and feeling like they were helping me. Back then, I thought they were angels. I was in the sky, thinking it was nighttime and looking at the stars. After some time, being amazed by the sight, I suddenly appeared in the church I always attended. I was facing the cross of Christ. He told me I was special and important, and then he had the two beings send me back to my body. I got better and was able to go home, but I never told my mom what had happened, since she never seemed interested. She did tell me, though, that while she was waiting to see if I would get better when I was asleep, a male nurse with a rosary around his neck gave her comfort. He told her I was meant for greatness, and I was special (even though he never saw me). They prayed for me, and she never saw him again. Ever since, I developed an interest in what happens to us when we die. I haven't feared death in a long time, since it sounded rather comforting to me since that time. I did cry when close family members died, but, somehow, I knew they would be happy.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: In the sky at night looking at the stars; later suddenly appeared in the church she attended, facing the cross of Christ.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Christ (at the cross in the church) told her she was special and important.
arrival.other_being_detail: Two kind, warming presences; she thought they were angels; they were helping her and later sent her back to her body.

environment.environment_other_detail: Nighttime sky with stars; later, the church she always attended, facing the cross of Christ.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe childhood illness; taken to hospital and later returned 'on the verge of death' and passed out.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter with Christ at the cross in her church; two beings sent her back to her body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Passed out and found herself in the night sky looking at stars, then suddenly appeared in her church facing the cross of Christ, then was sent back to her body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Sudden shift of setting from a starry night sky to the church she attended; mother separately encountered a male nurse with a rosary who comforted her and said the child was 'meant for greatness' and 'special,' then was never seen again.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “He told me I was special and important.” / “I was meant for greatness, and I was special.”
